L13@P0: imports averaged 129,000 barrels per day last week.

L25@P0: increased by 1.2 million barrels last week.

L27@P0: million barrels per day, up by 5.0% from the same period last year. Over
L28@P0: the last four weeks, motor gasoline product supplied averaged about

L33@P0: period last year.

L36@P0: conventional gasoline in the New York Harbor was $1.829 per gallon,
L37@P0: $0.038 more than last week’s price and $0.107 higher than a year ago.

L39@P0: per gallon, $0.109 over last week’s price and $0.381 above a year ago.

L41@P0: per gallon on January 1, 2018, $0.048 above last week’s price and
L42@P0: $0.143 more than a year ago. The national average retail diesel fuel price
L43@P0: increased to $2.973 per gallon, $0.070 per gallon over last week and
L44@P0: $0.387 above a year ago.
